runs.text: Mathematical functions compute roots, logarithms and trigonometry with results exact to the last bit, and rounding functions go from real to integer in four different ways.
Mathematical functions accept integers or reals and return reals:

The result is always the real closest to the exact value, on any machine: it does not depend on the system's maths library.
